source_species_detail: T10 forceps-clamp SCI; scRNA-seq, lesion and BMDM assays
assay_or_perturbation: clodronate macrophage depletion; bazedoxifene; anti-C1q antibody; C1q staining; VGLUT2/PSD95 engulfment assays
pathway_or_branch: foam-cell lipid accumulation to C1q-associated synaptic engulfment
citation_note: Peng et al.; primary SCI lipid-complement mechanism
evidence_summary: Foam-cell lipid accumulation increased C1q and pathological synaptic engulfment; lipid lowering and C1q blockade preserved synapses and improved motor recovery.
limitations: C1q receptor was not isolated; C1q cellular source requires cell-specific validation; bazedoxifene target specificity unresolved.

source_species_detail: Female mouse T10 crush SCI; myelin-debris and macrophage/microglia compartments
assay_or_perturbation: TREM2 knockout; COG1410 short- versus long-term activation; debris uptake, PI3K/AKT, DAM, BMS and footprint assays
citation_note: Wu et al.; primary SCI debris-sensor study
evidence_summary: TREM2 loss impaired myelin-debris engulfment/degradation and PI3K/AKT-linked DAM activation; activation was beneficial early but harmful when prolonged.
limitations: No purified debris-TREM2 binding assay; timing is bidirectional and chronic activation increased fibrosis/inflammation.

source_species_detail: Human SCI CSF; mouse dorsal-column lesion; rat optic-nerve crush
assay_or_perturbation: western blot; neurite/growth-cone assays; activated protein C in vitro/in vivo
pathway_or_branch: activated protein C protease activity to histone-H3 neurite-inhibition rescue
citation_note: Siddiq et al.; primary histone-DAMP study
evidence_summary: Extracellular histone H3 inhibited neurite growth through TLR2/YB-1-associated signaling and activated protein C reversed the inhibitory effect in comparator systems.
limitations: APC benefit was not shown through PAR1; coagulation cascade was not measured; optic-nerve rescue is not direct traumatic-SCI treatment.

source_species_detail: Mouse traumatic SCI; BLT1 knockout versus wild type; leukocyte and neuronal co-culture contexts
source_scope: lipid mediator receptor and neutrophil recruitment
assay_or_perturbation: BLT1 knockout; histology/MPO; sorted leukocyte gene expression; neuronal co-culture; recovery assays
citation_note: Saiwai et al.; LTB4-BLT1 axis study
evidence_summary: The LTB4-BLT1 axis amplified neutrophil recruitment and secondary injury after SCI; BLT1 loss altered inflammatory and recovery-associated outcomes.
limitations: Neutrophils also contribute to repair; BLT1 is an amplification factor rather than the sole recruitment route.

source_species_detail: Male CD1 mice; T6-T7 clip-compression SCI
source_scope: lipid mediator and cysteinyl-leukotriene receptor context
assay_or_perturbation: zileuton 50 mg/kg; montelukast 5 mg/kg; PGE2/LTB4 assays; MPO, ERK/TNF/COX-2, apoptosis and locomotor assays
citation_note: Genovese et al.; 5-LO/leukotriene pharmacology after SCI
evidence_summary: Zileuton and montelukast reduced lipid mediator-associated inflammation, neutrophil activity, tissue injury, and locomotor deficits.
limitations: Pharmacology does not isolate all 5-LO metabolites or prove an endogenous ligand-receptor edge; early mouse model only.

source_species_detail: Mouse SCI; intrathecal RvD3 with RAW264.7 and hCMEC/D3 mechanistic assays
assay_or_perturbation: intrathecal resolvin D3; inflammatory cytokine and neuroprotection assays
citation_note: Kim et al.; resolvin D3 SCI study
evidence_summary: RvD3 promoted inflammatory resolution and neuroprotection after SCI.
limitations: Receptor-level assignment was not established in the local extraction; downstream function cannot be promoted to a direct receptor edge.

source_species_detail: Rat SCI; RvD1 plus peripheral-nerve-derived stem-cell spheroids
source_scope: pro-resolving lipid mediator and regenerative co-therapy
assay_or_perturbation: RvD1 co-administration; cytokine assays; qRT-PCR; IHC; behavior
citation_note: Jeong et al.; RvD1 co-therapy study
evidence_summary: RvD1 co-administration reduced inflammatory signals and supported regenerative outcomes in a combination treatment context.
limitations: Effect cannot be assigned to RvD1 alone; no receptor or proximal-relay dissection.

source_species_detail: Rat impact SCI; peritraumatic neurons and tissue
assay_or_perturbation: ATP exposure; OxATP or PPADS; electrophysiology and cell-death observations
citation_note: Wang et al.; primary P2X7R SCI pharmacology
evidence_summary: Sustained extracellular ATP and P2X7R antagonism were associated with calcium overload, neuronal death, histological injury, and functional deficits.
limitations: Abstract-level local extraction; PPADS is not P2X7-specific and direct receptor selectivity is bounded.

source_species_detail: Rat thoracic weight-drop SCI; microglia, astrocytes, neutrophils and lesion tissue
assay_or_perturbation: systemic Brilliant Blue G 15 min after injury; histology and motor behavior
pathway_or_branch: P2X7R blockade to microglial/gliotic inflammation and recovery
citation_note: Systemic P2X7 antagonist study; species corrected from the Module18A row
evidence_summary: Brilliant Blue G reduced microglial/astrocyte activation, neutrophil infiltration, tissue loss, and motor deficits after traumatic SCI.
limitations: Species discrepancy in the local Module18A row; Brilliant Blue G has multiple cellular targets and is not cell-specific.

source_species_detail: Mouse T10 contusion; microglia-neuron/astrocyte cultures and ex vivo slices
assay_or_perturbation: P2Y12R restoration with P2Y-TK-Nano; ATP/adenosine assays; P2Y12R, CD39/CD73, A1R and mitophagy blockade; behavior
pathway_or_branch: P2Y12R to CD39/CD73-adenosine-A1R to PINK1/Parkin/LC3 mitophagy
citation_note: Tian et al.; primary P2Y12R dual-targeting study
evidence_summary: P2Y12R restoration increased CD39/CD73-mediated ATP-to-adenosine conversion and neuronal mitophagy; blockade attenuated protection and treatment improved lesion, axon/myelin, and locomotor outcomes.
limitations: Nanoparticle targeting, cargo, ROS responsiveness, and receptor restoration confound attribution; direct ATP-P2Y12 binding is not claimed.

source_species_detail: Male Sprague-Dawley T10 contusion; human SCI serum
assay_or_perturbation: DNase I 5 mg/kg; trap imaging/TEM/flow; LL37-P2X7R co-IP and NF-kB assays; human serum correlations
citation_note: Zhang et al.; primary MET/P2X7 study
evidence_summary: Macrophage extracellular traps and LL37 were associated with P2X7R/NF-kB inflammatory signaling; DNase I reduced trap burden and improved tissue/conduction/motor outcomes.
limitations: DNase I is not receptor-specific; P2X7R necessity was not genetically tested; human data are observational.

source_species_detail: Rat SCI with peripheral-nerve-derived stem-cell spheroids; lesion and repair compartments
source_scope: pro-resolving lipid mediator and regenerative co-therapy

citation_note: Jeong et al.; primary RvD1 co-therapy study
evidence_summary: RvD1 co-administration reduced inflammatory signals and supported regenerative outcomes in a combination treatment context.
limitations: Effect cannot be assigned to RvD1 alone; no cognate receptor or receptor-proximal relay was dissected.

source_species_detail: Traumatic SCI; injured spinal cord and lesion vasculature
source_scope: C3 breakdown-fragment targeting by engineered CR2-Crry
assay_or_perturbation: C3 deficiency; intravenous CR2-Crry; C3/CR2 immunostaining; radiolabeled biodistribution; BBB, tissue-sparing, neutrophil assays
pathway_or_branch: C3 breakdown fragments target CR2-Crry and complement inhibition improves SCI pathology
citation_note: Bermpohl et al.; primary CR2-Crry SCI study
evidence_summary: Deposited C3 breakdown fragments targeted the CR2 domain of CR2-Crry; C3-level inhibition improved tissue sparing and locomotor recovery.
limitations: This is engineered inhibitor targeting, not endogenous intact-C3 activation of CR2; fragment identity was not resolved to C3b, iC3b, C3d, or C3dg.

source_species_detail: Ventral-root avulsion and sciatic-nerve transection injury; spinal motor-neuron synapse compartment
source_scope: complement receptor and injury-associated synapse context
assay_or_perturbation: Cr2 expression profiling; Cr2-knockout mice; synaptophysin and C1q/C3 measurements
pathway_or_branch: CR2-associated injury response and synaptic terminal modulation
evidence_summary: Injury-associated CR2 expression and Cr2 loss altered synaptic terminal loss in a peripheral nerve injury model.
limitations: Not contusive SCI; direct C3-fragment binding and intracellular CR2 relay were not tested.

source_species_detail: Rat SCI with primary astrocyte and macrophage assays
assay_or_perturbation: HMGB1 stimulation; TLR2/TLR4 inhibitors; ERK/JNK/NF-kB assays
pathway_or_branch: HMGB1-associated TLR2/4 to ERK/JNK to NF-kB inflammatory recruitment
evidence_summary: HMGB1-associated TLR2/4 inhibition reduced ERK/JNK/NF-kB-linked inflammatory signaling and CCL5-associated recruitment.
limitations: No purified SCI binding assay; TLR2 and TLR4 contributions were paired in the evidence and are not separable here; retain as DAMP/TLR boundary context.

source_species_detail: Rat spinal cord ischemia-reperfusion injury
assay_or_perturbation: S100A8 manipulation; TAK-242; ERK/NF-kB, apoptosis, and inflammation assays
pathway_or_branch: S100A8-associated TLR4 to ERK/NF-kB inflammatory injury
evidence_summary: S100A8 manipulation and TLR4 inhibition associated S100A8 with TLR4-ERK/NF-kB inflammatory injury.
limitations: No direct biochemical binding; TLR4 pharmacology and S100A8 perturbation do not fully isolate the receptor complex; DAMP/TLR boundary context.

source_species_detail: Rat contusion SCI; spinal pain and sensory compartments
assay_or_perturbation: P2X4 expression; ATP-evoked calcium; dehydrocorybulbine; P2X agonist challenge
pathway_or_branch: ATP-P2X4R calcium signaling and neuropathic pain
evidence_summary: ATP-evoked P2X4-associated calcium signaling was linked to neuropathic pain after contusion SCI.
limitations: Pharmacologic rather than purified binding evidence; receptor selectivity remains bounded.

assay_or_perturbation: CCR2 knockout; monocyte recruitment and myelin-removal assays
pathway_or_branch: CCL2/CCR2-dependent monocyte recruitment and myelin clearance
evidence_summary: CCR2 loss altered monocyte/macrophage recruitment and myelin removal after contusion SCI.
limitations: Genetic receptor evidence without purified ligand-binding assay; likely overlaps a frozen Module 20A LR classification and is retained here only as downstream function.

limitations: Neutralization and recruitment evidence, not purified binding; likely overlaps a frozen Module 20A LR classification and is retained here only as downstream function.

assay_or_perturbation: Expression profiling; CCL3 knockout; pain and locomotor assays
pathway_or_branch: CCL3-associated secondary damage with CCR1 co-expression context
citation_note: Primary SCI expression and knockout studies
evidence_summary: CCL3 and CCR1 were co-induced in injured cord, while CCL3 loss reduced secondary damage and pain-associated outcomes.
limitations: CCR1 was not directly blocked or activated; retain as context, not a direct CCL3-CCR1 edge.

assay_or_perturbation: Recombinant decorin infusion; plasminogen/plasmin protein and mRNA assays

evidence_summary: Decorin altered plasminogen/plasmin-associated protease activity and CSPG remodeling in a manner associated with axon-growth permissiveness.
limitations: Supports protease adjacency, not decorin-TLR2 signaling or a direct decorin-receptor edge.

pathway_or_branch: TLR4 signaling upstream of MMP9 and ECM remodeling
evidence_summary: TLR4 deletion altered MMP9 expression and ECM remodeling, supporting a reverse-direction pathway context for the MMP9-TLR4 candidate.
limitations: Evidence does not support MMP9 activating TLR4; retain direction explicitly as TLR4-to-MMP9 pathway context.
